observation.command: cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && stat -c "%y %n" appsettings.json bin/Debug/net8.0/appsettings.json local.json bin/Debug/net8.0/local.json bin/Debug/net8.0/Bovis.Web.dll appsettings.Development.json 2>&1; echo "=== full env of PID 1655 (filtered for Web/Settings) ==="; tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/1655/environ | grep -i -E "web|setting|auth|cookie|Bovis" ; echo "(end)"; echo "=== any other processes listening? ==="; ls /proc/net/tcp | head -1; awk 'NR>1 {split($2,a,":"); port=strtonum("0x" a[2]); if ($4=="0A") print port}' /proc/net/tcp | sort -u
